sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the explanation of the three levels above in terms of the three loves is placed at the beginning because the three loves are the root and cause for the drawing down of these three levels.

translations.translation: And one must understand,
that at first glance,
the explanation of the connection of the three loves to the three levels above comes after understanding the concepts of the three levels,
and from the flow of the topics in the maamar it seems that this matter
[that these three levels are the three loves]
adds explanation to the three levels.
And one could say from the explanations in this,
that the reason that there are three levels above in which all revelations are included,
is,
that all the revelations above are for the sake of man's service,
and since in the love of G-d
[which is the essence of service,
for there is no worship like the worship of love62]
there are three loves,
with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might,
therefore the entirety of all revelations above is divided into three levels
(Memale, Sovev, and the Essence of Ein Sof that is above Sovev)
corresponding to the three loves mentioned above.
And since understanding a matter thoroughly is achieved by explaining it from its foundation and root,
therefore,
the beginning of the explanation
(in the maamar)
of the three levels above is how the three loves are in them,
for this is the root and cause for the drawing down of the three levels.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the three levels of Memale, Sovev, and Atzmus Ein Sof are revealed through man's service of the three loves, so that man becomes a partner in the revelation itself, elevating it beyond its intrinsic state.

translations.translation: And)
And one could say,

that the inner reason for this, that the drawing down and revelation of the three matters of Memale, Sovev, and Atzmus Ein Sof is through the three loves of with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might,
is,
that the intention in all the revelations is so that through them the creation of the world will subsequently take place,
and therefore,
just as the creation of the world was in a manner that all the matters within it63
would be rectified through man's service,
so that through this man would be a partner with the Holy One, blessed be He, in the work of creation,
so too is it regarding the revelations above,
that their coming into being
(their drawing down)
was in a manner that their revelation64
would be through man's service,
so that man's partnership with the Holy One, blessed be He, in the work of creation would be not only in the world itself but also in the revelations above through which the world was created.
And since the essence of man's service is the love of G-d, for there is no worship like the worship of love
(as above),
therefore,
the revelation of the three levels mentioned above
(in which all matters above are included),
is through the three loves of with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
And through the matters above being drawn down and revealed through man's service,
an ascent is made in them to a higher level than they are in their own intrinsic state65.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that Moshe's prayer specifically drew down the revelation of Atzmus Ein Sof above Sovev into Malchus, because through service from below upward, the light is elevated and its infinite permanence is established.

translations.translation: And this is "A prayer of Moshe,"
that the drawing down of the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof that is above Sovev, which Moshe drew into Malchus, was specifically through prayer,
even though since Moshe is the supernal Da'at that receives from Atik
(the Essence of Ein Sof that is above Sovev)
he was capable of drawing this light into Malchus in a manner from above to below,
for through the drawing down of the light being through prayer,
man's service
(in a manner from below upward),
the intention for which the light was emanated is fulfilled,
and through this an ascent is made in it and addition is made to its infinite permanence.
For its infinite permanence is not only as it is in its own intrinsic state,
the essence of the light in which no tzimtzum or withdrawal applies,
but rather
(also)
as it is from the perspective of the Essence.
And therefore,
the building of Malchus that is made through the light as it is drawn down through Moshe's prayer is an eternal building.
